metadata.name: OASIS
metadata.description: OASIS (oasis.os.fan) signup - native module. LOCALE-INDEPENDENT selectors (page renders in the proxy's language). ADAPTIVE details form: fills only the fields the page actually renders - location only, names without a location, or the full form. If the email is already joined the site skips straight to the skip-step page; the module clicks through and still records the entry, without duplicating a row that already exists. City/country/phone from the proxy geo; DOB random 18+; names/email from the profile identity.

config.selector: input[name="Email" i]:visible, input[type="email"]:visible, input[autocomplete="email" i]:visible, input[placeholder*="email" i]:visible, input[aria-label*="email" i]:visible
